text: Request or hire the aid of Lords and Heroes for your faction. Their rarity is counterbalanced by unique skills and potential.

Recruit emerging companies that have acquired fame in recent exploits.||Once unlocked, these units can be recruited like Regiments of Renown.||Note: these units originate from player stories and are informally known as Regiments of Community.

Use your economical, military and political leverage to enact maneuvres and start initiatives.||Each type of Strategy will also lock analogous initiatives for the duration.||For maximum efficiency, timing is of the essence, especially around Great Surge strategies that can only be enacted once each!

Send emissaries to 'acquire' precious items. All items purchased will be added to your Magical Items pool to be equipped by a character from their Character Details panel.||Certain items are expensive to be acquired, one way or another, others are so delightfully unique there is no chance of finding another specimen!
